claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage.targetMarkedBySpellFilter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The advantage applies only to attack rolls made against the creature currently bearing Hunter's Mark. The existing modify_roll_advantage atom has no field to scope the effect to the marked target. All current filters (attackerTypeFilter, skillFilter, conditionFilter, saveAbilityFilter, saveSourceFilter) constrain by attacker type, skill, condition, or save ability/source — none express 'the target that has spell X's mark on it'. A new optional field (e.g. markedBySpell: spellId, or a general targetStateFilter referencing the mark attachment) is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on attack rolls against the creature currently marked by your Hunter's Mark.
